_doc: Models on MSI's ComfyUI. prompt: tags (Danbooru tags: illustrious, anima) or text (sentences: flux, krea2); by default from the family. Read by msi/scripts/comfy_generate.py and the web-interface (Mila Draw AI). Order = order in the web-interface. references: the model takes reference images (FLUX edit graph, settings in edit_params).

krea2-turbo.name: Krea 2 Turbo 12B (INT8 convrot)
krea2-turbo.title: Krea 2 Turbo
krea2-turbo.source: https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Krea-2 (diffusion_models/krea2_turbo_int8_convrot.safetensors, sha256 8e4eeda70dd5…); settings: ComfyUI template «Text to Image (Krea-2 Turbo)»
krea2-turbo.note: 8-step distilled, guidance baked in: CFG 1, negative does not work. Text encoder and VAE are the same files as FLUX 3 Klein / Anima (hashes checked). 12B does not fit 8 GB VRAM: ComfyUI offloads part to RAM. License: Krea 2 Community License, commercial use via opensource@krea.ai
